svg.title: Flow figure: Ask for a pickup, Told: too many requests, Told: no worker free, Gets paid, Under the limit?, Accept the request, Worker free?, Assign the job, Paid in cash?, Settle the voucher, Pump and weigh, Customer signs, Phone syncs, Record refused, Allowed to sell?, Save collection and voucher, Add to stock. Steps: Normal pickup, Paid in cash, Too many requests, No worker free, Expired certification.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Ask for a pickup, Told: too many requests, Told: no worker free, Gets paid, Under the limit?, Accept the request, Worker free?, Assign the job, Paid in cash?, Settle the voucher, Pump and weigh, Customer signs, Phone syncs, Record refused, Allowed to sell?, Save collection and voucher, Add to stock. Normal pickup. The customer asks for a pickup in the app. The office accepts it and looks for a free worker. The office assigns the job. The worker gets a push. The worker weighs the oil. The customer signs. The server checks the client and saves both records together. The server adds the oil to the stock record. The office settles the voucher. Paid in cash. The office accepts and assigns the job. The worker collects the oil and pays cash. The voucher is already settled. Nothing waits for the office. Too many requests. The customer has too many open requests. The app refuses. No worker free. No worker is free. The office cannot accept the request. Expired certification. The request passes every office check. The worker collects the oil from the customer. Only now does the server see the expired certification.

g.text: The customer asks for a pickup in the app.
The office accepts it and looks for a free worker.
The office assigns the job. The worker gets a push.
The worker weighs the oil. The customer signs.
The server checks the client and saves both records together.
The server adds the oil to the stock record. The office settles the voucher.
The office accepts and assigns the job.
The worker collects the oil and pays cash.
The voucher is already settled. Nothing waits for the office.
The customer has too many open requests. The app refuses.
No worker is free. The office cannot accept the request.
The request passes every office check.
The worker collects the oil from the customer.
Only now does the server see the expired certification.
